d: A habit is an action that you do often and almost without thinking.
A habitat is the natural environment where a particular plant or animal lives.
Your hair is the mass of thin thread-like structures that grows on your head.
A half is one of two equal parts of something that has been divided.
A hall is a long passage in a building with doors leading into rooms.
A hammer is a tool with a heavy metal head used for hitting nails.
Your hand is the part of your body at the end of your arm that has fingers.
If you handle a situation, you successfully deal with it or manage it.
If a man is handsome, he has a very attractive face.
If you hang something, you attach its top part to a hook so that the bottom is free.
If an event happens, it takes place or occurs, often by chance.
If you are happy, you feel feelings of pleasure and satisfaction.
If something is hard, it is solid and firm to the touch, or difficult to do.
You use hardly to say that something is almost not true or almost does not happen.
If you harm someone or something, you physically injure or damage them.
If something is harmful, it can cause damage or injury to people or things.
Harmony is a state of peace where people live together without fighting.
A hat is a piece of clothing that you wear on your head.
If you hate someone or something, you have a very strong feeling of dislike for them.
If you have something, you own it, possess it, or keep it.
You use he to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned.
Your head is the top part of your body containing your brain, eyes, and mouth.
A headache is a continuous, dull pain inside your head.
If a wound or a sick person heals, they become healthy and normal again.
Your health is the general condition of your body and mind.
If you are healthy, you are physically strong and not suffering from any illness.
When you hear a sound, you become aware of it through your ears.
Hearing is the physical ability to perceive sounds with your ears.
Your heart is the organ in your chest that pumps blood around your body.
Heat is the quality of being hot, or the high temperature of something.
Heaven is the place where some religions believe good people go after they die.
If it rains heavily, a lot of rain falls very quickly and forcefully.
If something is heavy, it weighs a lot and is difficult to lift.
Your heel is the rounded back part of your foot.
Height is the measurement of how tall a person or thing is.
A helicopter is an aircraft with long blades on top that spin to help it fly.
Hell is the place where some religions believe bad people are punished after death.
You say hello to someone when you meet them as a friendly greeting.
A helmet is a hard hat worn to protect the head when riding a bike or working.
If you help someone, you do something to make their task easier or solve their problem.
If someone is helpful, they are willing and happy to assist other people.
You use her to refer to a woman or girl who is receiving an action.
A hero is a person who is admired for doing something very brave or great.
If you hesitate, you pause before doing something because you are unsure or nervous.
If you hide, you go somewhere where nobody can see or find you.
If something is high, it extends a long way upwards from the ground.
If you highlight a problem or subject, you draw people's attention to it.
You use highly to mean very, to a large degree, or at a great level.
A highway is a wide public road designed for cars traveling at high speeds.
A hill is a raised area of land that is smaller and lower than a mountain.
You use him to refer to a man or boy who is the object of an action.
A hint is a small piece of advice or information that helps you guess something.
If you hire someone, you give them a job and pay them to do it.
You use his to show that something belongs or relates to a specific man or boy.
A historian is a person who studies and writes about past events.
History is the study of people, events, and societies from the past.
If you hit someone or something, you strike them with a lot of physical force.
If you hold something, you carry it or support it securely in your hands.
A hole is an empty space opening into or through a solid surface.
A holiday is a special day of rest when people do not go to work or school.
If something is hollow, it has an empty space inside it.
If something is holy, it is considered highly sacred and connected to God.
Your home is the house or apartment where you currently live.
Homework is the school tasks that teachers give students to complete at home.
If someone is honest, they always tell the truth and do not steal or cheat.
You use honestly to emphasize that you are telling the complete truth.
Honey is a sweet, sticky yellow liquid made by bees from flowers.
Honor is a strong feeling of pride and the respect you receive from others.
A hook is a curved piece of metal or plastic used for catching or hanging things.
If you hope for something, you want it to happen and believe that it might.
If you are hopeful, you feel positive that good things will happen in the future.
The horizon is the line far away where the sky seems to meet the land or ocean.
A horn is the hard, pointed part that grows on the heads of animals like cows and goats.
If something is horrible, it is very unpleasant, bad, or frightening.
Horror is a strong feeling of great shock, fear, or disgust.
A horse is a large animal that people ride or use for pulling heavy wagons.
A hospital is a large building where sick or injured people receive medical care.
A host is someone who invites people to a party or event and takes care of them.
If something is hot, it has a very high temperature and can burn you.
A hotel is a building where you pay to sleep in a room while traveling.
An hour is a period of time equal to exactly sixty minutes.
A household consists of all the people living together in one house.
Housing refers to buildings or houses that are provided for people to live in.
You use how to ask about the way in which a thing happens or is done.
You use however to introduce a statement that contrasts with what was just said.
If something is huge, it is extremely large in size or amount.
Human means relating to people rather than animals or machines.
Humor is the quality of being funny, or the ability to find things amusing.
A hundred is the number 100, which is equal to ten times ten.
Hunger is the painful physical feeling you get when you need to eat food.
If you are hungry, your stomach feels empty and you want to eat.
If you hunt, you chase wild animals in order to catch or kill them.
A hunter is a person or an animal that chases and kills other animals for food.
A hurricane is a massive, violent storm with extremely strong circular winds.
If you hurry, you do something or go somewhere as quickly as possible.
If you hurt yourself or someone else, you cause physical pain or injury.
A woman's husband is the man she is legally married to.
A hut is a small, simple building made of wood, grass, or mud.
A house is a building where people, usually one family, live.
If a building houses something, it serves as the safe place where that thing is kept.
